aboutMe: I'm a Tech Lead DevOps Engineer with over 15 years of experience in IT, managing multicultural global teams. My main business expertise is retail and banking, where I've helped integrate different groups by creating pipelines to make Development, Operations, and Security areas work together. My goal is to help companies, from all backgrounds and sizes, move to DevOps culture, integrating agile methodologies, to achieve fast and secure development and production deployments.
